## Research software

Open-source implementations and research code accompanying my work in
data-driven constitutive modelling, computational mechanics and geomechanics ([GitHub profile](https://github.com/filippo-masi))

###### [Constitutive transport learning](https://github.com/filippo-masi/constitutive-transport-learning)

Learning inelastic constitutive models directly from stress–strain data under
hard thermodynamic constraints. The framework combines neural free-energy
potentials with state-dependent generalised transport operators, enforcing
thermodynamic consistency by construction.

###### [NICE — Neural Integration for Constitutive Equations](https://github.com/filippo-masi/NICE)

A deep-learning framework for the automatic discovery of constitutive equations
from small, sparse and incomplete material-state observations. NICE formulates
constitutive learning as an initial-value problem and uses neural differential
equations to identify the evolution of material state variables.

###### [Thermodynamics-based Artificial Neural Networks (TANN)](https://github.com/filippo-masi/Thermodynamics-Neural-Networks)

Reference implementation of thermodynamics-based neural architectures for
constitutive modelling of inelastic materials. Thermodynamic relations are
embedded directly in the neural architecture through automatic differentiation.

###### [TANN-multiscale](https://github.com/filippo-masi/TANN-multiscale)

Micromechanical simulations, training workflows and finite-element examples for
multiscale modelling of inelastic materials with TANN. The repository includes
tools for generating microscale data and examples coupling learned constitutive
models with finite-element analyses.

###### [Terraquake](https://github.com/filippo-masi/Terraquake)

Research code for the constitutive and hydrodynamic modelling of fault gouges
and frictional dynamics, connecting material-scale behaviour with
earthquake-like instabilities.


## Teaching and hands-on material

###### [Machine Learning for Physics (UGA)](https://github.com/aimechanics/machine-learning-for-physics)

Course material for *Machine Learning for Physics* in the M2 MSIAM programme at Université Grenoble Alpes, co-taught with Vincent Acary, Michael Arbel and
Henri Leroy. The repository contains lecture slides and hands-on material on physics-informed learning, operator learning, structured models and
differentiable solvers.

###### [ALERT Geomaterials Doctoral School 2023 — Machine Learning in Geomechanics](https://github.com/alert-geomaterials/2023-doctoral-school)
Shared course repository for the 2023 ALERT Geomaterials Doctoral School on *Machine Learning in Geomechanics*. It collects lecture material and hands-on
notebooks from the teaching team.


###### [ALERT Olek Zienkiewicz School — Constitutive modelling meets Machine Learning](https://github.com/filippo-masi/ALERT-OlekZienkiewicz-ML)

Hands-on notebooks and material for learning constitutive equations from
experimental geomaterial data, prepared for the ALERT Olek Zienkiewicz
Doctoral School.

###### [CSMA Workshop — Deep Learning and Constitutive Modelling](https://github.com/filippo-masi/CSMA-Workshop-in-Deep-Learning)

Course material, notebooks and practical exercises on physics-informed
data-driven constitutive modelling and Thermodynamics-based Artificial Neural
Networks.
